items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: I heard a lot of records by Boyd Centa... I heard him all over the the place, you know?

ctx.x: What about a Boyd Centa? I mean he made a great number of records.

I heard a lot of records by Boyd Centa, and he probably made more records than anybody at that time -- I heard him all over the place, you know? But I was not particularly interested in sounding like, you know, he sounded. He had a good sound, as I remember, and I guess what he was doing, somebody considered it jazz. You know? And you know how I feel about the term, so I won't go in to that!
